facts.fact: The ministerial order of 13 September 2023 (JORT no. 106, 15 September 2023) requires public bodies' software, platforms and infrastructure to be hosted in-house or with cloud providers according to four tiers, and makes any other arrangement subject to prior ANCS approval.
facts.system: Arrete du 13 septembre 2023 (G-cloud and N-cloud labels)

facts.fact: The order sets the hosting tiers as the body's own private cloud, a G-cloud labelled government provider, an N-cloud labelled national provider, and unlabelled providers, with ANCS issuing the labels, valid one year, to Tunisian providers with data centres on Tunisian territory.

systems.country_label: Fournisseur de services informatiques en nuage gouvernemental (G-cloud)
systems.tiers: second tier: used between government structures

systems.country_label: Fournisseur de services informatiques en nuage national (N-cloud)
systems.tiers: third tier: used by government structures for businesses or citizens
